name: Wine cellar
desc: Things kept out of sight: old money, old bottles, and a conversation held below the house.
tags: wine cellar, brick barrel vaulted ceiling, stone walls, wooden wine racks, dusty bottles lying on their sides, oak barrels, flagstone floor, iron candle sconce, cobwebs, wooden crates, narrow stone steps, single hanging bulb
prose: a vaulted brick cellar lined with wooden racks of dusty bottles, oak barrels standing against the stone wall and a single bulb throwing light across the flagstones toward the steps
note: Old and atmospheric render as nothing; age has to be dust on the bottles, cobwebs and the brick vault overhead. Lose the VAULT and it becomes a modern wine shop with backlit glass racks. Underground means no daylight and no readable time of day, so name the actual source - bulb or candle sconce - and let the grade carry the dark.
